floor_law: floor_t = 0.04 * (1 + kappa * z_t), z_t standardized QT-window MORTGAGE30US (ddof=1), clipped >= 0; the window-mean pin holds only where the clip does not bind (realized means recorded per cell)

leg_families.true: realized cyclical path, FLOOR_MODE=max (the committed cell)
leg_families.perm: 12 permutations of the same path, FLOOR_MODE=max (multiset and mean preserved exactly; order destroyed)
leg_families.flat_equiv: convexity-matched constant floor, FLOOR_MODE=max (level alone; zero dispersion, zero order)
leg_families.additive: realized cyclical path, FLOOR_MODE=additive (Jensen/max channel off, co-movement untouched)

decomposition_note: departure = true - kappa0 baseline; level_equivalence = flat_equiv - baseline; dispersion = mean(perm) - baseline (order-free); residual_dispersion = dispersion - level_equivalence; time_order = departure - dispersion. Only time_order is attributable to co-movement with the rate cycle.
verdict: RANGE IS PREDOMINANTLY ORDER-FREE: the committed kappa grid bounds the marginal's sensitivity to within-run floor DISPERSION under the hard maximum, not its co-movement with the rate cycle; a genuine but small cyclicality component survives

neighbour_exposure_audit.floor_sweep: CLEAN — scalar constant floor per run (hazard/floor_sweep.py:124 sets one float); zero within-window dispersion, so a time-order permutation is a literal no-op. The level sweep is a genuine level sweep.
neighbour_exposure_audit.floor_form_test: CLEAN — scalar constant floors {3,4,5}% (hazard/floor_form_test.py:80); it varies the combination RULE, which is the correct diagnostic and is the control this module borrows.
neighbour_exposure_audit.oos_identification: CLEAN — scalar constant floor (hazard/oos_identification.py:258). The v17 headline +5.57pp / $42.6B off-window marginal is NOT exposed to this confound.
neighbour_exposure_audit.seasonal_floor_timing: EXPOSED — varies the floor within the run; already diagnosed as dispersion and already written up in revised_paper_v17.tex sec:robustness-seasonalfloor.
neighbour_exposure_audit.floor_cyclical: EXPOSED — varies the floor within the run; this module supplies the diagnosis it predates.
